finding: Existing optional HelperJobBudget0.1.0 already supports durable total budgets, POSIX nonblocking interprocess locks, deadlines, hash-linked reservations and restart/concurrency controls. New read-only legacyjournal audit must not be claimed as a novel global budget/coordinator capability.
new_audit_distinct_scope: Read-only reconstruction of four old standalone HelperRetrieval request/result/receipt triples that were not created under a HelperJobBudget job config. No lock/reservation/job-state import is provided.
decision: Do not integrate or replace existing coordinator; preserve the narrower audit and all results with honest scope. Prefer existing HelperJobBudget for any future explicit opt-in coordinated job.
